messages.content: Help the operator with each note: acknowledge the concrete change in a short normal sentence. In the SAME reply give only JSON {"answer":"...","tag":"...","global":[{"key":"...","value":"..."}]}. Invent a stable short nonempty tag per distinct job; reuse it whenever that job returns. Use UNRESOLVED if ambiguous. A workspace-wide persistent preference, and only such a preference, merits a global write on the turn introducing or changing it. Use concise lowercase English keys, e.g. footer for the workspace footer, and literal values. Otherwise global is []. Never promote job-specific codes or seals.
Open the Birch print job. Its print code starts at K14; stamp S58 on this job only.
